title: Grateful Dead Live at Boston Garden on 1982-09-18

ai_review.summary: A fan‑favorite show despite minor recording imperfections
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about the concert, calling it one of their all‑time favorites and praising the “great” tunes and overall vibe. The recording isn’t flawless – one listener notes it’s not perfect – but the performance shines through enough to earn repeat listens.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviewers gave 4‑star ratings and expressed strong enthusiasm for the music, outweighing the modest criticism of recording quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: One reviewer mentions it’s not a perfect recording, implying minor flaws but overall listenable.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific comments on song order; reviewers simply note the concert was enjoyable from start to finish.
